Container.Name: PI
Container.Overview: pi coding agent (earendil-works/pi) merged with the PI WEB browser client (jmfederico/pi-web) in one container: chat, file diffs, git worktrees, and real interactive terminals in the browser, with a session daemon so agent runs survive closing the tab. Lives at its own address 192.168.1.74 on br0 (reserve it in the UDM): web UI on :8504, and SSH on :22 straight into the pi TUI (quit pi to get bash; the login behavior is /data/home/.bash_profile, which is user data). SSH is key-only against /data/home/.ssh/authorized_keys unless PI_SSH_PASSWORD is set below; host keys persist in /data/ssh so clients never see them change. Image is built and version-tracked automatically at github.com/nphil/pi: a scheduled workflow watches npm for new pi/pi-web releases, bumps versions.json, and pushes a fresh :latest to GHCR, so this app simply shows an update in the Docker tab when upstream releases; Apply Update recreates from this template. Runs as nobody:users (sshd is the only root process) with a single /data mount. Internal only: LAN and tailnet, never exposed publicly. Note: on br0 the exposure watch's docker-port source cannot see this container's doors. Models come from llama-swap at :9292; the declared contextWindow values in /data/pi-agent/models.json must track the -c values in llama-swap's config.
Container.Requires: llama-swap up on :9292 for models. This template is the canonical container definition; Apply Update recreates from it. Reserve 192.168.1.74 in the UDM's DHCP so nothing else takes it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything: pi state (pi-agent/), pi-web state (pi-web/), config (config/), home + SSH authorized_keys (home/), SSH host keys (ssh/), and the agent workspace (workspace/)

Config.Name: PI_SSH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional. Set to allow SSH password login for the pi user; empty keeps SSH key-only (authorized_keys in /data/home/.ssh).
